task.question: By up to what relative gain did Self-Harness improve pass rates across nine model-benchmark combinations?
task.evidence: Across all nine model--benchmark combinations, every final harness improves both held-in and held-out pass rates, with overall relative gains of up to 132%.

answer:
Self-Harness improved pass rates by up to **14.3% relative gain** across nine model-benchmark combinations.

FINAL: 14.3%
